info.title: v2.discount.get_discount_list
info.description: Use this api to get shop discount activity list

get.description: Use this api to get shop discount activity list

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: discount_status
parameters.description: The status filter for retriveing discount list. Available value: upcoming/ongoing/expired/all.

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of data to return in the current call. Starting from 1. if data is more than one page, the page_no can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: If many items are available to retrieve, you may need to call GetDiscountsList multiple times to retrieve all the data. Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the Pagination filters to control the maximum number of entries (<= 100) to retrieve per page (i.e., per call), the offset number to start next call. This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: update_time_from
parameters.description: The update_time_from and update_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the discount update time). The maximum date range that may be specified with the update_time_from and update_time_to fields is 30 days.

parameters.name: update_time_to
parameters.description: The update_time_from and update_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the discount update time). The maximum date range that may be specified with the update_time_from and update_time_to fields is 30 days.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
